channel.title: Isabel Amrein
channel.description: Isabel Amrein De Luca, Lending Product Manager: projects and notes on data, generative AI and product. Learning by building, with my own examples.

item.title: From problem to match: how we would approach finding a home with AI
item.description: A class case study: how to go from a real problem, finding a home, to a data and AI idea with value, a business model and metrics.

item.title: Data strategy: purpose first, then the plan
item.description: A data strategy is a purpose plus a plan. How to place an organization by its maturity, and why data only creates value if the people who use it understand it.

item.title: Machine learning: when the data writes the rules
item.description: What machine learning is, how a project is built from start to finish, and why training the model is only the tip of the iceberg.
